Gentle Mates (formerly known as Gentle Mates Alpine prior to RLCS 2026) is a French esport organization which used to field a European Rocket League team.

History

[edit]

Timeline

[edit]
  • 2024
  • 2025
  • 2026
  • Show All
  • January 4th – Gentle Mates enter the Rocket League scene by acquiring the roster of itachi, Seikoo, and juicy, with Eversax as Coach.[1]
  • February 9th – Mout joins as Manager.[2]
  • December 2nd – itachi leaves.[3]
  • December 4th – Mout leaves Manager position.[4] Radosin and AzoX join.[5][4]
  • March 26th – Radosin leaves.[6]
  • April 12th – yujin joins.[7]
  • September 15th – Eversax changes role from Coach to Inactive Coach.[8]
  • October 8th – Seikoo, juicy, yujin and Eversax leave.[9]
  • October 11th – Oski, nass, Archie and Snaski join.[10]
  • October 26th – Gentle Mates disband, Archie, nass, Oski and Snaski leave the team.[11]
  • October 28th – Vatira, Atow and zen join.[12]

Trivia

[edit]

  • [e] 2026-09-19 | M8 Oski: "Archie speaks his mind a lot, which I like." at RLCS Worlds 2026
